Le bulbe réduit en poudre fournit un antidote de niveau 12 contre l’Acána ; cette poudre conserve ses propriétés pendant des années. Ironbine grows along the coasts and saltwater shores of southern Endor in mild temperate regions. Its bulbs are relatively easy to find. The plant is also known as Deathsaver and Lifeblossom.

The bulb, ground into powder, provides a level 12 antidote to Acána; the powder remains effective for years. The flower has a separate use: taken fresh, it immediately restores 2–10 concussion hits, but keeps for only about a week after picking. These two preparations should not be confused. Repeated use may cause habituation.
